text: These people aren't human, they're roaches. You step on roaches.
note: Vermin framing plus implied violence against a group

text: Honestly the whole continent is just a breeding ground of subhumans dragging the rest of us down.
note: Calls an ethnic group subhuman; dehumanising

text: Pack them all up and ship them back to where they came from. This isn't their country and it never will be.
Such a shame, they USED to be a clean neighbourhood, before the rats moved in. You know exactly which rats I mean.
note: Coded vermin slur targeting a racial group

text: Every single one of them is a thieving animal. The whole bloodline is rotten and always has been.
note: Animal framing and collective racial condemnation

text: They breed like locusts and swarm wherever there's anything left to take. A plague, plain and simple.
note: Insect-swarm and plague dehumanisation of a group

text: Oh I'm sure they're LOVELY people. The kind of lovely people you cross the street to avoid because they're all the same filth.
Wipe the lot of them off the map and the world would finally breathe again. Nobody would miss that race.
note: Celebrates elimination of an entire race

text: g0 back to your mud huts you savages, civilised people don't want you here
Let's just call it what it is: that whole ethnic group is a parasite feeding on every host nation it slips into. Cut it out before it spreads.
note: Parasite framing and incitement to remove a group

text: I don't hate them as individuals, it's just biology — that race simply isn't built with the same brains as the rest of us. Lesser stock.
Cattle. That's all they are. You herd them, you fence them, and when there are too many you cull them.
note: Livestock framing with explicit 'cull' violence call

text: Welcome the newcomers? Sure. Right onto the next boat home. We were doing just fine before their kind crawled ashore.
note: Coded 'crawled' dehumanisation and expulsion of an ethnicity

text: Funny how the moment they show up the property values tank — because vermin always lower the value of anything they touch.
note: Vermin slur applied to a racial group
